{"test_name":"Ledger_2297_Objection3","test_code":"using MessagePack.SourceGenerator;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.Syntax;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\n\npublic class Ledger_2297_Objection3\n{\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task AllGeneratedFormattersAndResolversHaveExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute()\n    {\n        string testSource = \"\"\"\nusing MessagePack;\n\nnamespace TestProject\n{\n    public enum SampleEnum\n    {\n        First = 0,\n        Second = 1,\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public class IntKeyClass\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public int Id { get; set; }\n\n        [Key(1)]\n        public SampleEnum Kind { get; set; }\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public struct IntKeyStruct\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public int Value { get; set; }\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public record IntKeyRecord\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public string Name { get; set; }\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public record struct IntKeyRecordStruct\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public int Count { get; set; }\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject(true)]\n    public class StringKeyClass\n    {\n        public int Id { get; set; }\n\n        public string Title { get; set; }\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject(true)]\n    public struct StringKeyStruct\n    {\n        public int Value { get; set; }\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject(true)]\n    public record StringKeyRecord\n    {\n        public string Name { get; set; }\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject(true)]\n    public record struct StringKeyRecordStruct\n    {\n        public int Count { get; set; }\n    }\n\n    [Union(0, typeof(UnionCaseA))]\n    [Union(1, typeof(UnionCaseB))]\n    public interface ISampleUnion\n    {\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public class UnionCaseA : ISampleUnion\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public int A { get; set; }\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public class UnionCaseB : ISampleUnion\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public string B { get; set; }\n    }\n\n    [Union(0, typeof(AbstractUnionCase))]\n    public abstract class SampleAbstractUnion\n    {\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public class AbstractUnionCase : SampleAbstractUnion\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public int X { get; set; }\n    }\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> frameworkReferences = await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None);\n        var messagePackReferences = ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack);\n        MetadataReference[] references = frameworkReferences.Concat(messagePackReferences).ToArray();\n\n        CSharpCompilation compilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"TestAssembly\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(testSource, new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest)) },\n            references,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator());\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(compilation, out Compilation output, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(generatorDiagnostics, d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error);\n        foreach (GeneratorRunResult result in runResult.Results)\n        {\n            Assert.Null(result.Exception);\n        }\n\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(output.GetDiagnostics(), d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error);\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? excludeFromCodeCoverageAttr = output.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute\");\n        Assert.NotNull(excludeFromCodeCoverageAttr);\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? formatterInterfaceOpen = output.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"MessagePack.Formatters.IMessagePackFormatter`1\");\n        Assert.NotNull(formatterInterfaceOpen);\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? resolverInterface = output.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"MessagePack.IFormatterResolver\");\n        Assert.NotNull(resolverInterface);\n\n        List<INamedTypeSymbol> generatedTypes = new();\n        foreach (GeneratedSourceResult source in runResult.Results.SelectMany(r => r.GeneratedSources))\n        {\n            SemanticModel model = output.GetSemanticModel(source.SyntaxTree);\n            SyntaxNode root = await source.SyntaxTree.GetRootAsync(CancellationToken.None);\n            foreach (BaseTypeDeclarationSyntax typeDecl in root.DescendantNodes().OfType<BaseTypeDeclarationSyntax>())\n            {\n                if (model.GetDeclaredSymbol(typeDecl) is INamedTypeSymbol symbol)\n                {\n                    generatedTypes.Add(symbol);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        List<(INamedTypeSymbol FormatterType, ITypeSymbol TargetType)> generatedFormatters = new();\n        List<INamedTypeSymbol> generatedResolvers = new();\n\n        foreach (INamedTypeSymbol generatedType in generatedTypes)\n        {\n            INamedTypeSymbol? formatterInterface = generatedType.AllInterfaces.FirstOrDefault(\n                i => SymbolEqualityComparer.Default.Equals(i.OriginalDefinition, formatterInterfaceOpen));\n            if (formatterInterface is not null)\n            {\n                generatedFormatters.Add((generatedType, formatterInterface.TypeArguments[0]));\n            }\n\n            if (generatedType.AllInterfaces.Any(i => SymbolEqualityComparer.Default.Equals(i, resolverInterface)))\n            {\n                generatedResolvers.Add(generatedType);\n            }\n        }\n\n        string[] expectedFormattedTypeNames = new[]\n        {\n            \"TestProject.SampleEnum\",\n            \"TestProject.IntKeyClass\",\n            \"TestProject.IntKeyStruct\",\n            \"TestProject.IntKeyRecord\",\n            \"TestProject.IntKeyRecordStruct\",\n            \"TestProject.StringKeyClass\",\n            \"TestProject.StringKeyStruct\",\n            \"TestProject.StringKeyRecord\",\n            \"TestProject.StringKeyRecordStruct\",\n            \"TestProject.ISampleUnion\",\n            \"TestProject.UnionCaseA\",\n            \"TestProject.UnionCaseB\",\n            \"TestProject.SampleAbstractUnion\",\n            \"TestProject.AbstractUnionCase\",\n        };\n\n        foreach (string expectedTypeName in expectedFormattedTypeNames)\n        {\n            INamedTypeSymbol? expectedTargetType = output.GetTypeByMetadataName(expectedTypeName);\n            Assert.NotNull(expectedTargetType);\n\n            (INamedTypeSymbol FormatterType, ITypeSymbol TargetType) match = generatedFormatters.FirstOrDefault(\n                f => SymbolEqualityComparer.Default.Equals(f.TargetType, expectedTargetType));\n            Assert.True(match.FormatterType is not null, $\"No formatter was generated for {expectedTypeName}.\");\n            Assert.True(\n                HasExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute(match.FormatterType, excludeFromCodeCoverageAttr!),\n                $\"Generated formatter '{match.FormatterType.ToDisplayString()}' for '{expectedTypeName}' is missing [ExcludeFromCodeCoverage].\");\n        }\n\n        Assert.NotEmpty(generatedResolvers);\n        foreach (INamedTypeSymbol resolverType in generatedResolvers)\n        {\n            Assert.True(\n                HasExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute(resolverType, excludeFromCodeCoverageAttr!),\n                $\"Generated resolver '{resolverType.ToDisplayString()}' is missing [ExcludeFromCodeCoverage].\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static bool HasExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute(INamedTypeSymbol typeSymbol, INamedTypeSymbol excludeFromCodeCoverageAttr)\n    {\n        return typeSymbol.GetAttributes().Any(\n            attr => SymbolEqualityComparer.Default.Equals(attr.AttributeClass, excludeFromCodeCoverageAttr));\n    }\n}\n"}
